I hope you are doing well.

We tried to ping the OCPP server from the router but was unable to connect, although we could successfully ping Google DNS (8.8.8.8). Please refer to the screenshot below.
It seems that the OCPP server is not responding. Could you please check with the OCPP backend to see if there are any issues with this charger ID?
